highlights.title: Close the window, Mewla stays
highlights.line: Mewla keeps running. Click it in the Dock and your draft is back. Quit Mewla quits.

highlights.title: Drop images from Safari or Chrome
highlights.line: Drag a picture out of a web page into the composer to attach it.

highlights.title: HTML pages open in Mewla
highlights.line: On a phone paired by address, a Session's HTML page opens in the app. Pinch to zoom.

highlights.title: Long chats open faster
highlights.line: A chat with hundreds of replies shows about a third sooner.
